name: Cubing at SkillCon 2015

venue.name: [Golden Nugget Hotel](http://www.goldennugget.com/lasvegas/)
venue.address: 129 E. Fremont St. Las Vegas, NV 89101
venue.details: Additional venue details TBA on competition website

information: This is a WCA competition presented in conjunction with SkillCon 2015. Registration for the 3x3 speedsolve event costs $35 before November 1, with additional events at $5 each. The registration fee also covers admission for SkillCon; check the [SkillCon website](http://www.skillcon.org) for more info on the other events and seminars that will be going on. Registration at the door will cost $50 and will be limited to 3x3 speedsolve only.
